import html # Template for rendering a blog post in HTML. The placeholders `{title}` and `{body}` # will be replaced with the sanitized values. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def render_blog_post(title: str, body: str) -> str: """ Render a user-generated blog post safely for display on a web page. Parameters ---------- title : str The blog post title provided by the user. body : str The main content of the blog post provided by the user. Returns ------- str The HTML string containing the sanitized title and body, formatted with BLOG_FORMAT. Notes ----- * The function uses `html.escape` to neutralize any potentially dangerous HTML or JavaScript code that could lead to Cross‑Site Scripting (CWE-79). This ensures that the output is safe for inclusion in a web page without further escaping. * The `escape` function also converts special characters such as `<`, `>`, and `&` into their corresponding HTML entities. """ # Sanitize inputs to prevent XSS safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True) # Format the sanitized content into the template return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
